service.method:
SELECT SETL.HOUSE_CODE , SETL.COMPANY_CODE , SETL.SMR_NUMBER , SETL.SMR_STATUS , SETL.ADD_DATE , SETL.ADD_TIME , SETL.ADD_USER_ID , #DB_OWNER#GETUSERNAME(SETL.HOUSE_CODE, SETL.COMPANY_CODE, SETL.ADD_USER_ID, ${session.LANGUAGE}) AS ADD_USER_NAME , SETL.CHANGE_DATE , SETL.CHANGE_TIME , SETL.CHANGE_USER_ID , SETL.DEL_FLAG , SETL.APPLY_TYPE , SETL.SUBJECT , SETL.SUBMISSION_PLACE , CAST(SETL.REMARK AS VARCHAR(4000)) AS REMARK , CAST(SETL.REJECT_REMARK AS VARCHAR(4000)) AS REJECT_REMARK , SETL.CONFIRM_DATE , SETL.CONFIRM_TIME , SETL.CONFIRM_USER_ID , SETL.SUBMIT_TYPE , CAST(SETL.SUBMIT_REMARK AS VARCHAR(4000)) AS SUBMIT_REMARK , SETL.EXT_OUT_EXPECT_DATE , SETL.EXT_USE_USER_ID , SETL.EXT_USE_PLACE , SETL.SEAL_USE_TYPE , SUBSTRING(SETL.EXT_OUT_EXPECT_TIME,1,2) AS EXT_OUT_EXPECT_HOUR , SUBSTRING(SETL.EXT_OUT_EXPECT_TIME,3,2) AS EXT_OUT_EXPECT_MINUTE , SETL.EXT_IN_EXPECT_DATE , SUBSTRING(SETL.EXT_IN_EXPECT_TIME,1,2) AS EXT_IN_EXPECT_HOUR , SUBSTRING(SETL.EXT_IN_EXPECT_TIME,3,2) AS EXT_IN_EXPECT_MINUTE , #DB_OWNER#GETUSERDEPTNAME(SETL.HOUSE_CODE, SETL.COMPANY_CODE, SETL.EXT_USE_USER_ID, ${session.LANGUAGE}) AS EXT_USE_DEPT_NAME_LOC , #DB_OWNER#GETUSERNAME(SETL.HOUSE_CODE, SETL.COMPANY_CODE, SETL.EXT_USE_USER_ID, ${session.LANGUAGE}) as EXT_USE_USER_NAME_LOC , #DB_OWNER#GETUSERNAME(SETL.HOUSE_CODE, SETL.COMPANY_CODE, SETL.CONFIRM_USER_ID, ${session.LANGUAGE}) as CONFIRM_USER_NAME_LOC , (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT SEAL.SUBJECT) FROM SSEDC_SEAL DC_SEAL JOIN SSEAL SEAL ON SEAL.HOUSE_CODE = DC_SEAL.HOUSE_CODE AND SEAL.COMPANY_CODE = DC_SEAL.COMPANY_CODE AND SEAL.MANAGE_NUMBER = DC_SEAL.MANAGE_NUMBER WHERE DC_SEAL.HOUSE_CODE = SETL.HOUSE_CODE AND DC_SEAL.COMPANY_CODE = SETL.COMPANY_CODE AND DC_SEAL.SMR_NUMBER = SETL.SMR_NUMBER GROUP BY DC_SEAL.HOUSE_CODE, DC_SEAL.COMPANY_CODE ) AS SEAL_NAMES , (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT DC_SEAL.MANAGE_NUMBER) FROM SSEDC_SEAL DC_SEAL WHERE DC_SEAL.HOUSE_CODE = SETL.HOUSE_CODE AND DC_SEAL.COMPANY_CODE = SETL.COMPANY_CODE AND DC_SEAL.SMR_NUMBER = SETL.SMR_NUMBER GROUP BY DC_SEAL.HOUSE_CODE, DC_SEAL.COMPANY_CODE ) AS MANAGE_NUMBERS FROM SSETL SETL LEFT OUTER JOIN SSEDC SEDC ON SETL.HOUSE_CODE = SEDC.HOUSE_CODE AND SETL.COMPANY_CODE = SEDC.COMPANY_CODE AND SETL.SMR_NUMBER = SEDC.SMR_NUMBER LEFT OUTER JOIN SUSMT USMT ON SETL.HOUSE_CODE = USMT.HOUSE_CODE AND SETL.COMPANY_CODE = USMT.COMPANY_CODE AND SETL.ADD_USER_ID = USMT.USER_ID LEFT JOIN SDEPT ADD_USER_DEPT ON ADD_USER_DEPT.HOUSE_CODE = USMT.HOUSE_CODE AND ADD_USER_DEPT.COMPANY_CODE = USMT.COMPANY_CODE AND ADD_USER_DEPT.DEPT = USMT.DEPT WHERE SETL.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SETL.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND SETL.SMR_NUMBER = $S{SMR_NUMBER} AND SETL.ADD_USER_ID = $S{REQ_USER_ID} AND IFNULL(SETL.APPLY_TYPE,'') != 'CEXT'
AND ( SETL.ADD_USER_ID = ${session.ID} OR ( ADD_USER_DEPT.DEPT = ${session.DEPARTMENT} AND SETL.SMR_STATUS != 'T' ) )
AND SETL.APPLY_TYPE IN ($INS{APPLY_TYPE}) AND SETL.SMR_STATUS IN($INS{SMR_STATUS}) AND (SETL.SUBJECT LIKE CONCAT('%', $S{F_KEYWORD}, '%') OR SETL.ADD_USER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', $S{F_KEYWORD}, '%') OR SETL.SMR_NUMBER LIKE CONCAT('%', $S{F_KEYWORD}, '%') OR SETL.SUBMISSION_PLACE LIKE CONCAT('%', $S{F_KEYWORD}, '%') OR USMT.USER_NAME_LOC LIKE CONCAT('%', $S{F_KEYWORD}, '%')) AND SETL.SEAL_USE_TYPE IN ($INS{REQ_SEAL_USE_TYPE}) AND SETL.ADD_DATE >= $S{F_CALENDAR_FROM} AND SETL.ADD_DATE <= $S{F_CALENDAR_TO} AND SEDC.SEAL_MG_USER_ID = $S{SEAL_MG_USER_ID} GROUP BY SETL.HOUSE_CODE , SETL.COMPANY_CODE , SETL.SMR_NUMBER , SETL.SMR_STATUS , SETL.ADD_DATE , SETL.ADD_TIME , SETL.ADD_USER_ID , SETL.CHANGE_DATE , SETL.CHANGE_TIME , SETL.CHANGE_USER_ID , SETL.DEL_FLAG , SETL.APPLY_TYPE , SETL.SUBJECT , SETL.SUBMISSION_PLACE , CAST(SETL.REMARK AS VARCHAR(4000)) , CAST(SETL.REJECT_REMARK AS VARCHAR(4000)) , SETL.CONFIRM_DATE , SETL.CONFIRM_TIME , SETL.CONFIRM_USER_ID , SETL.SUBMIT_TYPE , CAST(SETL.SUBMIT_REMARK AS VARCHAR(4000)) , SETL.EXT_OUT_EXPECT_DATE , SETL.EXT_USE_USER_ID , SETL.EXT_USE_PLACE , SETL.SEAL_USE_TYPE , SUBSTRING(SETL.EXT_OUT_EXPECT_TIME,1,2) , SUBSTRING(SETL.EXT_OUT_EXPECT_TIME,3,2) , SETL.EXT_IN_EXPECT_DATE , SUBSTRING(SETL.EXT_IN_EXPECT_TIME,1,2) , SUBSTRING(SETL.EXT_IN_EXPECT_TIME,3,2) ORDER BY SETL.SMR_NUMBER DESC

UPDATE SSETL SET CHANGE_DATE = ${current.DATE} , CHANGE_TIME = ${current.TIME} , CHANGE_USER_ID = ${session.ID} , DEL_FLAG = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${DEL_FLAG } , DEL_FLAG ) , SMR_STATUS = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${SMR_STATUS } , SMR_STATUS ) , SEAL_USE_TYPE = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${SEAL_USE_TYPE } , SEAL_USE_TYPE ) , SUBJECT = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${SUBJECT } , SUBJECT ) , REMARK = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${REMARK } , REMARK ) , REJECT_REMARK = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${REJECT_REMARK } , REJECT_REMARK ) , SUBMISSION_PLACE = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${SUBMISSION_PLACE} , SUBMISSION_PLACE) , EXT_USE_PLACE = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${EXT_USE_PLACE } , EXT_USE_PLACE ) , EXT_USE_USER_ID = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${EXT_USE_USER_ID } , EXT_USE_USER_ID ) , ATTACH_NO = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${ATTACH_NO } , ATTACH_NO ) , EXT_OUT_EXPECT_DATE = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${EXT_OUT_EXPECT_DATE } , EXT_OUT_EXPECT_DATE ) , EXT_OUT_EXPECT_TIME = LEFT(CONCAT(#DB_OWNER#NVL(${EXT_OUT_EXPECT_HOUR}, ''), #DB_OWNER#NVL(${EXT_OUT_EXPECT_MINUTE}, ''), '000000'),6) , EXT_IN_EXPECT_DATE = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${EXT_IN_EXPECT_DATE } , EXT_IN_EXPECT_DATE ) , EXT_IN_EXPECT_TIME = LEFT(CONCAT(#DB_OWNER#NVL(${EXT_IN_EXPECT_HOUR}, ''), #DB_OWNER#NVL(${EXT_IN_EXPECT_MINUTE}, ''), '000000'),6) WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND SMR_NUMBER = ${SMR_NUMBER}

SELECT HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , SMR_NUMBER , SMR_SEQ , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , ADD_USER_ID , CHANGE_DATE , CHANGE_TIME , CHANGE_USER_ID , DEL_FLAG , SEAL_TYPE , SEAL_MG_DEPT , #DB_OWNER#GETDEPTNAME(${session.HOUSE_CODE}, ${session.COMPANY_CODE}, SEAL_MG_DEPT , '') AS DEPT_NAME , SUBJECT , COUNT , ATTACH_NO , ATTACH2_NO , MANAGE_NUMBER , SMD_NUMBER , SEAL_MG_USER_ID , SEAL_MG_SUBJECT FROM SSEDC WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND SMR_NUMBER = ${SMR_NUMBER} AND SMD_NUMBER = $S{SMD_NUMBER} AND DEL_FLAG = 'N'

SELECT PDSE.HOUSE_CODE , PDSE.COMPANY_CODE , PDSE.SMR_NUMBER , PDSE.SMD_NUMBER , PDSE.MANAGE_NUMBER , PDSE.ADD_DATE , PDSE.ADD_TIME , PDSE.ADD_USER_ID , PDSE.ACCEPT_FLAG , PDSE.COMPLETE_FLAG , PDSE.MANAGER_ID , PDSE.MANAGE_DEPT , UPIM.ITEM_NAME , UPIM.ITEM_CODE , UPIM.ITEM_TYPE , UPIM.SEAL_WIDTH , UPIM.SEAL_HEIGHT , UPIM.ITEM_NO , SEAL.SEAL_USE_DEPT , SEAL.SEAL_MG_DEPT , SEAL.SUBJECT , SEAL.SEAL_MG_USER_ID , MAND.RECE_USER_ID , #DB_OWNER#GETUSERNAME(${session.HOUSE_CODE}, ${session.COMPANY_CODE}, SEAL.SEAL_MG_USER_ID , '#session.LANGUAGE#') AS SEAL_MG_USER_NAME , #DB_OWNER#GETDEPTNAME(${session.HOUSE_CODE}, ${session.COMPANY_CODE}, SEAL.SEAL_MG_DEPT , '#session.LANGUAGE#') AS DEPT_NAME , SEAL.SEAL_TYPE , #DB_OWNER#GETCODETEXT(${session.HOUSE_CODE}, 'SM003', #DB_OWNER#NVL(SEAL.SEAL_TYPE, ''), ${session.LANGUAGE}) AS SEAL_TYPE_NAME FROM SSEDC_SEAL PDSE INNER JOIN SSEAL SEAL ON SEAL.HOUSE_CODE = PDSE.HOUSE_CODE AND SEAL.COMPANY_CODE = PDSE.COMPANY_CODE AND SEAL.MANAGE_NUMBER = PDSE.MANAGE_NUMBER INNER JOIN SUPIM UPIM ON UPIM.HOUSE_CODE = SEAL.HOUSE_CODE AND UPIM.COMPANY_CODE = SEAL.COMPANY_CODE AND UPIM.ITEM_CODE = SEAL.SEAL_TYPE LEFT OUTER JOIN SMAND MAND ON MAND.HOUSE_CODE = PDSE.HOUSE_CODE AND MAND.COMPANY_CODE = PDSE.COMPANY_CODE AND MAND.GIVE_COMPANY_CODE = PDSE.COMPANY_CODE AND MAND.RECE_COMPANY_CODE = PDSE.COMPANY_CODE AND MAND.GIVE_USER_ID = PDSE.MANAGER_ID AND MAND.RECE_USER_ID = ${session.ID} AND ${current.DATE} BETWEEN MAND.START_DATE AND MAND.END_DATE WHERE PDSE.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND PDSE.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND PDSE.SMR_NUMBER = ${SMR_NUMBER} AND PDSE.SMD_NUMBER = $S{SMD_NUMBER} AND PDSE.ACCEPT_FLAG = $S{ACCEPT_FLAG} AND PDSE.COMPLETE_FLAG = $S{COMPLETE_FLAG}

SELECT HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , ITEM_NO , ITEM_CODE , ITEM_SEQ , ITEM_NAME , ITEM_TYPE , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , ADD_USER_ID , CHANGE_DATE , CHANGE_TIME , CHANGE_USER_ID , SYSTEM , CLASS , METHOD , DISPLAY_TEMPLATE , DISPLAY_EDIT , DEL_FLAG , SEAL_WIDTH , SEAL_HEIGHT FROM SUPIM WHERE #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND DISPLAY_EDIT = '1' ORDER BY ITEM_CODE ,ITEM_SEQ ASC

SELECT HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , SMR_NUMBER , SMI_NUMBER , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , ADD_USER_ID , CHANGE_DATE , CHANGE_TIME , CHANGE_USER_ID , DEL_FLAG , DOC_TYPE , CONTENTS , COUNT , PRINT_COUNT , DOWN_COUNT , CERTIFICATE_NO FROM SSISD WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND SMR_NUMBER = ${SMR_NUMBER} AND SMI_NUMBER = $S{SMI_NUMBER}

SELECT HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , SMI_NUMBER , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , ADD_USER_ID , CHANGE_DATE , CHANGE_TIME , CHANGE_USER_ID , DEL_FLAG , SUBJECT , CONTENT , DOC_TYPE FROM SSRAD WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND SMI_NUMBER = $S{SMI_NUMBER}

SELECT COMPANY_CODE ,CONT_NO ,CONT_GL_SEQ ,SEQ ,ADD_DATE ,ADD_TIME ,USER_COMPANY_CODE ,USER_ID ,ACTION ,IP ,#DB_OWNER#GETUSERNAME(${session.HOUSE_CODE}, ${session.COMPANY_CODE}, USER_ID, ${session.LANGUAGE}) AS USER_NAME ,#DB_OWNER#GETUSERDEPTNAME(${session.HOUSE_CODE}, ${session.COMPANY_CODE}, USER_ID, ${session.LANGUAGE}) AS USER_DEPT_NAME ,#DB_OWNER#GETCOMPANYNAME(${session.HOUSE_CODE}, ${session.COMPANY_CODE}, ${session.LANGUAGE}) AS USER_COMPANY_NAME FROM SPMGT WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND CONT_NO = ${SMR_NUMBER} AND CONT_GL_SEQ = '1' ORDER BY SEQ

SELECT SETL.HOUSE_CODE , SETL.COMPANY_CODE , SETL.SMR_NUMBER , SETL.SMR_STATUS , SETL.ADD_DATE , SETL.ADD_TIME , SETL.ADD_USER_ID , SETL.CHANGE_DATE , SETL.CHANGE_TIME , SETL.CHANGE_USER_ID , SETL.DEL_FLAG , SETL.SEAL_USE_TYPE , SETL.APPLY_TYPE , SETL.SUBJECT , CAST(SETL.REMARK AS VARCHAR(4000)) AS REMARK , SETL.SUBMISSION_PLACE , SETL.CONFIRM_DATE , SETL.CONFIRM_TIME , SETL.CONFIRM_USER_ID , SETL.SUBMIT_TYPE , SETL.EXT_OUT_DATE , SETL.EXT_IN_DATE , #DB_OWNER#GETUSERDEPTNAME(SETL.HOUSE_CODE, SETL.COMPANY_CODE, SETL.EXT_USE_USER_ID, ${session.LANGUAGE}) AS DEPT_NAME_LOC , #DB_OWNER#GETUSERNAME(SETL.HOUSE_CODE, SETL.COMPANY_CODE, SETL.ADD_USER_ID, ${session.LANGUAGE}) as ADD_USER_NAME_LOC , #DB_OWNER#GETUSERNAME(SETL.HOUSE_CODE, SETL.COMPANY_CODE, SETL.EXT_USE_USER_ID, ${session.LANGUAGE}) as USE_USER_NAME_LOC , #DB_OWNER#GETUSERNAME(SETL.HOUSE_CODE, SETL.COMPANY_CODE,SETL.CONFIRM_USER_ID, ${session.LANGUAGE}) as CONFIRM_USER_NAME_LOC FROM SSETL SETL LEFT OUTER JOIN SSEDC SEDC ON SETL.HOUSE_CODE = SEDC.HOUSE_CODE AND SETL.COMPANY_CODE = SEDC.COMPANY_CODE AND SETL.SMR_NUMBER = SEDC.SMR_NUMBER LEFT OUTER JOIN SUSMT ADD_USMT ON ADD_USMT.HOUSE_CODE = SETL.HOUSE_CODE AND ADD_USMT.USER_ID = SETL.ADD_USER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN SUSMT USE_USMT ON USE_USMT.HOUSE_CODE = SETL.HOUSE_CODE AND USE_USMT.USER_ID = SETL.EXT_USE_USER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN SUSMT CONFIRM_USMT ON CONFIRM_USMT.HOUSE_CODE = SETL.HOUSE_CODE AND CONFIRM_USMT.USER_ID = SETL.CONFIRM_USER_ID WHERE SETL.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SETL.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND SETL.SMR_NUMBER = $S{SMR_NUMBER} AND SETL.ADD_USER_ID = $S{REQ_USER_ID} AND SETL.SMR_STATUS IN($INS{SMR_STATUS}) AND IFNULL(SETL.APPLY_TYPE,'') != 'CEXT' AND (SETL.SUBJECT LIKE CONCAT('%', $S{F_KEYWORD}, '%') OR SETL.ADD_USER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', $S{F_KEYWORD}, '%') OR SETL.SMR_NUMBER LIKE CONCAT('%', $S{F_KEYWORD}, '%') OR SETL.SUBMISSION_PLACE LIKE CONCAT('%', $S{F_KEYWORD}, '%') OR ADD_USMT.USER_NAME_LOC LIKE CONCAT('%', $S{F_KEYWORD}, '%') OR USE_USMT.USER_NAME_LOC LIKE CONCAT('%', $S{F_KEYWORD}, '%') OR CONFIRM_USMT.USER_NAME_LOC LIKE CONCAT('%', $S{F_KEYWORD}, '%')) AND SETL.SEAL_USE_TYPE IN($INS{SEAL_USE_TYPE}) AND SETL.ADD_DATE >= $S{F_CALENDAR_FROM} AND SETL.ADD_DATE <= $S{F_CALENDAR_TO} AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM SSEDC_SEAL DCSE WHERE DCSE.HOUSE_CODE = SETL.HOUSE_CODE AND DCSE.COMPANY_CODE = SETL.COMPANY_CODE AND DCSE.SMR_NUMBER = SETL.SMR_NUMBER AND DCSE.MANAGER_ID = $S{MANAGER_ID})) GROUP BY SETL.HOUSE_CODE , SETL.COMPANY_CODE , SETL.SMR_NUMBER , SETL.SMR_STATUS , SETL.ADD_DATE , SETL.ADD_TIME , SETL.ADD_USER_ID , SETL.CHANGE_DATE , SETL.CHANGE_TIME , SETL.CHANGE_USER_ID , SETL.DEL_FLAG , SETL.SEAL_USE_TYPE , CAST(SETL.REMARK AS VARCHAR(4000)) , SETL.APPLY_TYPE , SETL.SUBJECT , SETL.SUBMISSION_PLACE , SETL.CONFIRM_DATE , SETL.CONFIRM_TIME , SETL.CONFIRM_USER_ID , SETL.SUBMIT_TYPE , SETL.EXT_USE_USER_ID , SETL.CONFIRM_USER_ID , SETL.EXT_OUT_DATE , SETL.EXT_IN_DATE ORDER BY SETL.SMR_NUMBER DESC

SELECT SETL.SMR_NUMBER, SETL.EXT_OUT_EXPECT_DATE, SETL.EXT_IN_EXPECT_DATE, SETL.EXT_OUT_EXPECT_TIME, SETL.EXT_IN_EXPECT_TIME, SEDC.MANAGE_NUMBER , SEDC.SEAL_MG_DEPT, SEDC.SEAL_MG_USER_ID, SEDC.SEAL_MG_SUBJECT, SETL.SMR_STATUS FROM SSETL SETL LEFT OUTER JOIN SSEDC SEDC ON SETL.HOUSE_CODE = SEDC.HOUSE_CODE AND SETL.COMPANY_CODE = SEDC.COMPANY_CODE AND SETL.SMR_NUMBER = SEDC.SMR_NUMBER WHERE ( ( ( CONCAT(${EXT_OUT_EXPECT_DATE}, LEFT(CONCAT(#DB_OWNER#NVL(${EXT_OUT_EXPECT_HOUR}, ''),'000000'), 6)) BETWEEN CONCAT(EXT_OUT_EXPECT_DATE, EXT_OUT_EXPECT_TIME) AND CONCAT(EXT_IN_EXPECT_DATE, EXT_IN_EXPECT_TIME) ) OR ( CONCAT(${EXT_IN_EXPECT_DATE}, LEFT(CONCAT(#DB_OWNER#NVL(${EXT_IN_EXPECT_HOUR}, ''),'000000'), 6)) BETWEEN CONCAT(EXT_OUT_EXPECT_DATE, EXT_OUT_EXPECT_TIME) AND CONCAT(EXT_IN_EXPECT_DATE, EXT_IN_EXPECT_TIME) ) ) OR ( ( CONCAT(EXT_OUT_EXPECT_DATE, EXT_OUT_EXPECT_TIME) BETWEEN CONCAT(${EXT_OUT_EXPECT_DATE}, LEFT(CONCAT(#DB_OWNER#NVL(${EXT_OUT_EXPECT_HOUR}, ''), '000000'), 6)) AND CONCAT(${EXT_IN_EXPECT_DATE}, LEFT(CONCAT(#DB_OWNER#NVL(${EXT_IN_EXPECT_HOUR}, ''),'000000'), 6)) ) OR ( CONCAT(EXT_IN_EXPECT_DATE, EXT_IN_EXPECT_TIME) BETWEEN CONCAT(${EXT_OUT_EXPECT_DATE}, LEFT(CONCAT(#DB_OWNER#NVL(${EXT_OUT_EXPECT_HOUR}, ''),'000000'), 6)) AND CONCAT(${EXT_IN_EXPECT_DATE}, LEFT(CONCAT(#DB_OWNER#NVL(${EXT_IN_EXPECT_HOUR}, ''), '000000'), 6)) ) ) ) AND SMR_STATUS IN ('RW','RR','I','W') AND SEDC.MANAGE_NUMBER = ${MANAGE_NUMBER}

SELECT SETL.SMR_NUMBER, SETL.EXT_OUT_EXPECT_DATE, SETL.EXT_IN_EXPECT_DATE, SETL.EXT_OUT_EXPECT_TIME, SETL.EXT_IN_EXPECT_TIME, SEDC.MANAGE_NUMBER , SEDC.SEAL_MG_DEPT, SEDC.SEAL_MG_USER_ID, SEDC.SEAL_MG_SUBJECT, SETL.SMR_STATUS FROM SSETL SETL LEFT OUTER JOIN SSEDC SEDC ON SETL.HOUSE_CODE = SEDC.HOUSE_CODE AND SETL.COMPANY_CODE = SEDC.COMPANY_CODE AND SETL.SMR_NUMBER = SEDC.SMR_NUMBER LEFT OUTER JOIN SSEDC_SEAL DCSL ON SEDC.HOUSE_CODE = DCSL.HOUSE_CODE AND SEDC.COMPANY_CODE = DCSL.COMPANY_CODE AND SEDC.MANAGE_NUMBER = DCSL.MANAGE_NUMBER AND SEDC.SMR_NUMBER = DCSL.SMR_NUMBER AND SEDC.SMD_NUMBER = DCSL.SMD_NUMBER WHERE DCSL.COMPLETE_FLAG = 'N' AND SMR_STATUS IN ('RW','RR','I','W') AND SEDC.MANAGE_NUMBER = ${MANAGE_NUMBER}
